verse.verse_5: The sun and the moon are in a reckoning.
verse.verse_6: And the herbs and the trees do obe isance."
verse.verse_7: And the heaven! He hath elevated it, and He hath set the balance.
verse.verse_8: That ye should not trespass in respect of the balance.
verse.verse_9: And observe the weight with equity, and make not deficient the balance.
verse.verse_10: And the earth! He hath lain it out for the creatures.
verse.verse_11: Therein are fruit and palm-trees sheathed.
verse.verse_12: And grain chaffed and other food.
verse.verse_13: Which, then, of the benefits of your Lord, will ye twain belie?
verse.verse_14: He created man of clay like, Unto pottery.
verse.verse_15: And He created the Jinn of a flame of fire.
verse.verse_16: Which, then, of the benefits of your Lord will ye twain belie
verse.verse_17: He is Lord of the two easts and Lord of the two wests.
verse.verse_18: Which, then, of the benefits of your Lord will ye twain belie?
verse.verse_19: He hath let loose the two seas.
verse.verse_20: In-between the twain is a barrier which they pass not.
verse.verse_21: Which, then, of the benefits of your Lord will ye twain belie?
verse.verse_22: There come forth from the twain the pearl and the coral.
verse.verse_23: Which, then, of the benefits of your Lord will ye twain belie?
verse.verse_24: His are the ships with elevated sails upon the sea like mountains.
verse.verse_25: Which, then, of the benefits of your Lord will ye twain belie?
verse.verse_26: Everyone that is thereon will Pass away.
verse.verse_27: And there will remain the countenance of thine Lord, Owner of Majesty and Beneficence.
verse.verse_28: Which, then, of the benefits of your Lord, will ye twain belie?
verse.verse_29: Of Him beggeth whosoever is in the heavens and the earth; every day He is in a new affair.
verse.verse_30: Which, then, of the benefits of your Lord will ye twain belie?
verse.verse_31: Anon We shall direct Our selves to you, O ye two classes.
verse.verse_32: Which, then, of the benefits of your Lord will ye twain belie?
verse.verse_33: O assembly of Jinn and man! if ye be able to pass out of the regions of the heavens and the earth, then pass out; ye can not pass out except with authority.
verse.verse_34: Which, then, of the benefits of your Lord will ye twain belie?
verse.verse_35: There shall be sent against you both flame of fire and smoke, and ye shall not be able to defend yourselves.
verse.verse_36: Which, then, of the benefits of your Lord will ye twain belie?
verse.verse_37: And when the heaven will be rent in sunder and will become rosy like Unto red hide.
verse.verse_38: Whfch, then, of the benefits of your Lord will ye twain belie!
verse.verse_39: Of his sin will be questioned that Day neither man nor jinn.
verse.verse_40: Which, then, of the benefits of your Lord will ye twain belie?
verse.verse_41: The culprits will be recognised by their marks, and will be lain hold of by the forelocks and the feet.
verse.verse_42: Which, then, of the benefits of your Lord will ye twain belie?
verse.verse_43: Yonder is the Hell which the culprits belied.
verse.verse_44: Going round between it and balling water fierce.
verse.verse_45: Which, then, of the benefits of your Lord will ye twain belie?
verse.verse_46: And for him who dreadeth the standing before his Lord will be two Gardens.
verse.verse_47: Which, then, of the benefits of your Lord will ye twain belie?
verse.verse_49: Which, then, of the benefits of your Lord will ye twain belie?
verse.verse_50: In which, will be two fountains running.
verse.verse_51: Which, then, of the benefits of your Lord will ye twain belie?
verse.verse_52: In which will be of every fruit two kinds.
verse.verse_53: Which, then, of the benefits of your Lord will ye twain belie?
verse.verse_54: Reclining on carpets whereof the linings will be of brocade; and the fruit of the two Gardens shall be near at hand.
verse.verse_55: Which, then, of the benefits of your Lord will ye twain belie?
verse.verse_56: Therein shall be those of refraining looks whom before them hath deflowered neither man nor jinn.
verse.verse_57: Which, then, of the benefits of Your Lord will ye twain belie?
verse.verse_58: As though they are jacinth and coral.
verse.verse_59: Which, then, of the benefits of your Lord will ye twain belie?
verse.verse_60: Shall the recompense of kindness be aught save kindness?
verse.verse_61: Which, then, of the benefits of your Lord will ye twain belie?
verse.verse_62: And beside the two there will be two other Gardens.
verse.verse_63: Which, then, of the benefits of your Lord will ye twain beli?
verse.verse_65: Which, then, of the benefits of your Lord will ye twain belie?
verse.verse_66: In which will be two fountains gushing forth.
verse.verse_67: Which, then, of the benefits of your Lord will ye twain belie?
verse.verse_68: In which will be fruit, the date-palm and pomegranate.
verse.verse_69: Which, then, of the benefits of Your Lord will ye twain belie?
verse.verse_70: Therein will be damsels agreeable and beauteous.
verse.verse_71: Which, then, of the benefits of your Lord will ye twain belie?
verse.verse_73: Which, then, of the benefits of Your Lord will ye twain belie?
verse.verse_74: There hath deflowered them neither man nor jinn.
verse.verse_75: Which, then, of the benefits of Your Lord will ye twain belie?
verse.verse_76: Reclining upon cushions green and carpets beauteous.
verse.verse_77: Which, then, of the benefits of your Lord will ye twain belie?
verse.verse_78: Blest be the name of thine Lord, Owner Of Majesty and Beneficence!
